provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Earth Reborn rulebook (Z-Man Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose a scenario (play them in order, starting with #1); it lists the rules in play
Build the map from the scenario: board frame, floor tiles and doors
Decide who plays which faction; a Player Aid screen in front of each player
The scenario's Character cards in front of each screen, Healthy side up
Their miniatures on the map where the scenario shows
All Order tiles in the cloth bag
Command Point / Wound counters in a shared bank
Do any other setup the scenario lists
Scenario text beats the rules when they disagree
Each turn starts with the Initiative Phase: draw Order tiles and gain Command Points
